author: Comics Explained
description:
▸ With the release of Storm: Earth's Mightiest Mutant (2026) issue 4, I saw a lot of confusion come up regarding the Omniverse and what it means for Marvel Comics. What is the difference between the Multiverse and the Omniverse? Has Marvel made reference to the Omniverse in the past? What did certain characters mean when referencing the Omniverse? Lets clear some things up.
